name: Neumann Gradient
aliases: Gradient estimation based on linear regression
definition: Gradient estimation taking 26 neighboring voxels as input. Based on linear regression, it produces nearly isotropic gradients with less fringing artifacts. It also allows filtering original voxel values with low additional cost.
summary: The Neumann Gradient estimates volume gradients by fitting a regression hyperplane to 26 neighbors, producing nearly isotropic results that reduce staircase artifacts compared to simple finite differences.
